note: Technique IDs/names from MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise (attack.mitre.org). Prevalence weights (1-5) are illustrative, for prioritization practice. Detection status describes a fictional client.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.test: Send a benign, pre-approved simulated phishing email to a test mailbox; confirm alert + quarantine.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.test: Sign in to a test account from an unusual location/VPN exit; confirm an anomaly alert fires.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.test: Run an authorized vulnerability scan against a staging app; confirm WAF alerts reach the SOC.

techniques.name: External Remote Services
techniques.test: Connect to the VPN with a test account outside business hours; confirm logging and alerting.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.test: Run a harmless encoded PowerShell 'hello world' on a test host; confirm EDR flags encoded commands.

techniques.name: User Execution
techniques.test: Open a benign test document with macros on a lab machine; confirm the macro policy blocks it.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job
techniques.test: Create and delete a benign scheduled task on a test host; confirm an alert on task creation.

techniques.name: Create Account
techniques.test: Create a temporary test user outside the normal process; confirm an alert and ticket.

techniques.name: Account Manipulation
techniques.test: Add a test user to an admin group and remove it; confirm a privileged-group-change alert.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
techniques.test: Add a benign run-key entry on a lab host; confirm EDR detects the autostart change.

techniques.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
techniques.test: Review EDR coverage on unpatched hosts from the vulnerability scan; verify alerting policy (no live exploit).

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
techniques.test: Trigger a benign UAC elevation from a non-standard path on a lab host; confirm telemetry is captured.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses
techniques.test: Attempt to stop the EDR service on a lab host with an approved test account; confirm tamper alert.

techniques.name: Indicator Removal
techniques.test: Clear a test host's application log; confirm a log-cleared alert.

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.test: Drop a base64-encoded harmless text file via a script on a lab host; review EDR visibility.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.test: Make repeated failed logins against a dedicated test account; confirm brute-force/spray alerts.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping
techniques.test: Use the EDR vendor's built-in safe test to simulate LSASS access; confirm block + alert.

techniques.name: Credentials from Password Stores
techniques.test: Review whether browser credential-store access by unusual processes is logged on lab hosts.

techniques.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation
techniques.test: Send several MFA pushes to a test account and deny them; confirm an MFA-fatigue alert.

techniques.name: Account Discovery
techniques.test: Run a bulk directory query from a standard test account; confirm it's visible in logs.

techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.test: Run an authorized port scan from a lab subnet; confirm the IDS alerts.

techniques.name: Remote System Discovery
techniques.test: Run a ping sweep from a lab host; confirm telemetry.

techniques.name: Remote Services
techniques.test: RDP between two lab hosts with a test account that normally doesn't; confirm an anomaly alert.

techniques.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material
techniques.test: Review detection logic for token/ticket reuse with the identity team; table-top first.

techniques.name: Email Collection
techniques.test: Create an auto-forward rule to an external test address in a test mailbox; confirm an alert.

techniques.name: Archive Collected Data
techniques.test: Compress a folder of dummy files with a password on a lab host; confirm telemetry.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.test: Copy a file tagged with a DLP canary label; confirm DLP alert.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.test: Generate beacon-like HTTPS requests from a lab host to an approved test domain; confirm beacon detection.

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.test: Download a benign test binary via a command-line tool on a lab host; confirm alert.

techniques.name: Protocol Tunneling
techniques.test: Review DNS analytics for unusually long/high-volume queries; validate with a vendor test feed.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
techniques.test: Upload a large dummy file to an unsanctioned cloud-storage test account; confirm volume alert.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.test: Send steady outbound traffic from a lab host to an approved test server; confirm anomaly detection.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
techniques.test: Attempt outbound traffic on a non-standard port from a lab host; confirm firewall alert.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.test: Run the EDR vendor's ransomware simulation on a lab host; confirm block + isolation.

techniques.name: Inhibit System Recovery
techniques.test: Attempt to list (not delete) shadow copies with an admin test account; confirm alerting on vssadmin usage.

techniques.name: Service Stop
techniques.test: Stop a non-critical service on a lab host; confirm an alert for service-stop bursts.
